raw_http_text: {"id":"5aecb167-8642-4d1f-a3ca-9ba88e4e3c4f_2srimug3z7lbx5shds_001ad70842534c7ca0eb7ab3e46bffcb","choices":[{"finish_reason":"stop","index":0,"message":{"content":"{\"schema_version\":\"1.0\",\"packet_id\":\"CAND_TOPIC_01_R2_V1\",\"mode\":\"organized_reflection\",\"sentences\":[{\"text\":\"大气二氧化碳增加会使溶入海洋的二氧化碳随之增加，但该证据未给出某一年吸收的比例、速度或上限。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E04\"],\"kind\":\"limitation\"},{\"text\":\"海洋酸化指氢离子浓度上升、pH下降的方向，海水平均仍呈碱性与继续酸化并不矛盾，判断应比较变化方向。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E05\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"2016年植被变绿研究区分观测与归因：叶面积增加可被检出，各驱动因素的作用大小则需借助模型判断。\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"paraphrase\"},{\"text\":\"在依赖模型判断各驱动因素贡献的条件下，观测到的叶面积增加能否直接写成某种因素的独立贡献？\",\"citations\":[\"CL_E06\"],\"kind\":\"question\"}]}","role":"assistant","tool_calls":null}}],"created":1794399610,"model":"mimo-v2.6-flash","object":"chat.completion","usage":{"completion_tokens":219,"prompt_tokens":1748,"total_tokens":1967,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0},"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":0}}}
